feed.title: Does Delta Air Lines Regret Not Ordering The Boeing 787-10 Sooner?

feed.title: Moody’s shifts Eastman Chemical outlook on cash flow concerns By Investing.com
feed.summary: Moody's Ratings has downgraded Eastman Chemical Company's outlook from stable to negative due to concerns over lower-than-expected operating cash flow for 2026 and challenges in consistent earnings growth. The revision reflects an anticipated operating cash flow of $900 million for 2026, which is lower than previous years, and elevated debt leverage. Moody's also highlighted the company's exposure to soft construction and automotive demand and destocking in the acetate tow market as factors likely to constrain earnings growth.

feed.title: Yankees Scripted Series Coming to Netflix, Will Be Set Across Multiple Eras of Team's History
feed.summary: Netflix is developing a new scripted drama series about the New York Yankees, which will cover multiple eras of the team's history. This project is part of Netflix's expanding partnership with MLB, following previous docuseries and a three-year streaming deal announced in December 2025. The series is being developed by MLB Studios, Jason Bateman's Aggregate Films, and Josh Wakely, who also conceived the concept.

feed.title: Alaska Airlines Vs. Delta: Who's Winning The Seattle Long-Haul Battle Right Now?
feed.summary: The rivalry between Delta Air Lines and Alaska Airlines at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport is intensifying, particularly in the long-haul international market. Delta is reinstating flights to Tokyo Narita and expanding its international network, while Alaska Airlines is aggressively growing its long-haul services to Asia and Europe following its acquisition of Hawaiian Airlines. Although Alaska dominates Seattle's overall market share due to its strong domestic network, Delta currently holds the larger share in the international long-haul segment, setting the stage for increased competition.

feed.title: Omeros Corporation (OMER) Investigation: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Gro

feed.title: Roche Stock Jumps as Morgan Stanley Sees Drug Breakout
feed.summary: Roche's stock climbed after Morgan Stanley upgraded the pharmaceutical giant to Overweight, boosting its price target due to strong prospects for its breast-cancer drug, giredestrant. The bank anticipates giredestrant will achieve higher sales and faster market penetration than previously expected, significantly impacting Roche's earnings. Despite the positive outlook and robust core business performance, the article notes that Roche's current stock valuation is nearly 40% above its intrinsic value, implying that future gains will rely heavily on successful execution and favorable FDA decisions regarding giredestrant.

feed.title: Tesla Stock Jumps Nearly 4% as $16.8 Billion Terafab Breaks Ground
feed.summary: Tesla's stock saw a nearly 4% increase after the company, in partnership with SpaceX, announced the groundbreaking and initial funding for Terafab, a massive $16.8 billion semiconductor manufacturing campus in Texas. This project aims to bring chip production in-house for Tesla's Optimus robots, self-driving vehicles, and SpaceX's orbital data centers. While the move could significantly strengthen Tesla's AI capabilities and reduce supplier dependency, it also presents substantial risks given the enormous capital and execution challenges inherent in semiconductor fabrication.
